paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者希望把一份说明文档做到约定的清晰标准，却不要求新增功能、公开表扬或保证它一定改变决策。完成标准、学到新东西、后续被使用是三种资料。一项任务未达目标也不能用“我重视成就”的选择替代实际检查。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader wants an explanatory document to meet an agreed clarity standard without requiring a new feature, public praise or a changed decision. paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks for the fictional document’s completion standard and how to check its feasibility without equating quantity or slogans with quality. Reading alone suffices without submitting work or competing. Counts establish no diligence, performance or occupational qualification.

paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these added scenes and discussion cards. Reading alone suffices and existing observations are optional. Keep one ordinary next-role setting throughout, with fair pay, safety and legal conditions already required rather than traded away. Each of thirty four-option choices contributes one count; declining three alternatives establishes no rejection. Ten priorities each appear twelve times, three per position, with four co-exposures per pair. Thirty choices are no personality total. Rank is one plus the number of priorities with greater counts: 6, 6, 4 yield ranks 1, 1, 3. Three choices each retain all ten highest readings. No fixed top-three cutoff or hidden winner applies. An edit subtracts one from its original value and adds one to another, establishing no lasting priority change. Balanced exposure validates neither wording, ten independent factors nor precision. This original ten-priority bank has no established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese equivalence. CareerOneStop / O*NET’s six-value model supplies no inherited validity or career recommendations. Counts infer neither ability, character, satisfaction, health nor job fit. Fictional discussion needs no employer, income or personal-history disclosure. All ten full guides remain public. Existing page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged; copying includes only the public title and entry.
